intents.title: Overhaul Radial and Constellation maps, enforce 100% Lucide icons, and reformat examples/demo-project for genuine 4-layer architecture
intents.statement: Enforce 100% Lucide icons across Studio. Fix root wrapper collapse, canonical hierarchical keys, hover lineage, power-law sector weighting, and rich tooltips in RadialMap. Build dedicated ConstellationMap with node-level vs parent-level fallback, directional 3-hop BFS, bidirectional cycle detection, progressive disclosure badges, and clickable edges. Reformat examples/demo-project so the backend serves all 8 domains, 4 layers, 4 states, node-level edges, and violations natively.
